user.title: Stepwise
user.description: Guided step by step procedures. The two thresholds below are the important settings: they decide when a half-finished thing is assumed, named, or offered.

data.search_response_path: Path to the result in the response

data_description.hot_minutes: Within this, "next" means the run in progress, with no preamble.
data_description.cold_hours: Past this, a run is offered rather than assumed: "you've a loaf half done, carry on or something new?"
data_description.confirmation_style: Waiting to be told is safer when hands are busy.
data_description.search_rest_command: Only needed when looking things up through a rest_command.
data_description.search_base_url: Only needed when using the bundled provider add-on, for example http://localhost:8080

subjects.title: Things
subjects.description: Everything Stepwise knows you have. Retired ones stay readable.

subject.title: {subject}
subject.description: What this one is called, and what has been learned about it. Anything learned here applies to this one thing and never to others of the same sort.

data_description.retract: Each one shows where it came from and when it was last confirmed.
data_description.retire: It stops matching what you say, but its history stays.
data_description.forget: Anything ticked is removed. A fact that cannot be removed is permanent.

runs.title: Put a run down
runs.description: Closes a run without finishing it. Nothing is lost and nothing is held against you.
